subject: science
concept: Understanding Newton's Second Law: force equals mass times acceleration
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pushes physical objects of different masses with similar force and compares resulting acceleration
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a force/mass scenario to its correctly calculated acceleration using F=ma
exercise.abstract: Student calculates force, mass, or acceleration using Newton's Second Law given the other two values

misconception_flags: assumes a heavier object always accelerates more under the same applied force

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
